description: Curated crates.io native-compilation compatibility corpus for Trust
limitations: This corpus is curated; it is not a downloads-ranked or exhaustive crates.io census.
A pass establishes native unverified compilation for the exact locked versions in the receipt, not verified downstream proc-macro support.
Each generated top-level fixture has an empty main; proc-macro targets may be compiled, but the corpus does not inventory or independently attest each macro invocation.
Results apply only to the host and toolchain identities recorded in the receipt.
selection: widely used crates spanning proc macros, async, networking, parsing, compression, cryptography, and native build scripts
